controls.name: Access control
controls.evidence: RBAC + ABAC (care-team) designed; ABAC service not fully deployed

controls.name: Encryption / decryption
controls.evidence: AES-256 at rest, CMEK for audio, field-level for transcripts

controls.name: Audit controls
controls.evidence: Append-only audit_events + Cloud Logging mirror; HMAC chain in design

controls.name: Integrity
controls.evidence: Transcript HMAC + append-only; not yet on all collections

controls.name: Person/entity authentication
controls.evidence: MFA for admins; clinician MFA delegated to health-system IdP

controls.name: Transmission security
controls.evidence: TLS 1.3 + mTLS; SMART on FHIR OAuth to EMR

controls.name: Risk analysis
controls.evidence: STRIDE register drafted (T-001..T-014); formal SRA not complete

controls.name: Security incident procedures
controls.evidence: No documented IR procedures at program start

controls.name: De-identification (Safe Harbor)
controls.evidence: NER+regex scrubber; no labeled-corpus validation suite (T-007)
